text_en: Machine translated by theksepyro. Some of the first lines retranslated by ewk on the podcast. No. 2010 Inscription on Faith in Mind The Supreme Way is not difficult. Just disdain value-creating discrimination. Just do not be averse or attached.

text_zh: 至道無難　唯嫌揀擇　但莫憎愛 洞然明白　毫釐有差　天地懸隔 欲得現前　莫存順逆　違順相爭 是為心病　不識玄旨　徒勞念靜 圓同太虛　無欠無餘　良由取捨 所以不如　莫逐有緣　勿住空忍 一種平懷　泯然自盡　止動歸止 止更彌動　唯滯兩邊　寧知一種 一種不通　兩處失功　遣有沒有 從空背空　多言多慮　轉不相應 絕言絕慮　無處不通　歸根得旨 隨照失宗　須臾返照　勝却前空 前空轉變　皆由妄見　不用求真 唯須息見　二見不住　慎勿追尋 纔有是非　紛然失心　二由一有 一亦莫守　一心不生　萬法無咎 無咎無法　不生不心　能隨境滅 境逐能沈　境由能境　能由境能 欲知兩段　元是一空　一空同兩 齊含萬像　不見精麁　寧有偏黨 大道體寬　無易無難　小見狐疑 轉急轉遲　執之失度　心入邪路 放之自然　體無去住　任性合道 逍遙絕惱　繫念乖真　沈惛不好 不好勞神　何用疎親　欲趣一乘 勿惡六塵　六塵不惡　還同正覺 智者無為　愚人自縛　法無異法 妄自愛著　將心用心　豈非大錯 迷生寂亂　悟無好惡　一切二邊 妄自斟酌　夢幻空華　何勞把捉 得失是非　一時放却　眼若不眠 諸夢自除　心若不異　萬法一如 一如體玄　兀爾忘緣　萬法齊觀 歸復自然　泯其所以　不可方比 止動無動　動止無止　兩既不成 一何有爾　究竟窮極　不存軌則 啟心平等　所作俱息　狐疑盡淨 正信調直　一切不留　無可記憶 虛明自然　不勞心力　非思量處 識情難測　真如法界　無他無自 要急相應　唯言不二　不二皆同 無不包容　十方智者　皆入此宗 宗非促延一念萬年萬年一念　無在不在 十方目前　極小同大　妄絕境界 極大同小　不見邊表　有即是無 無即是有　若不如是　必不須守 一即一切　一切即一　但能如是 何慮不畢　信心不二　不二信心 言語道斷　非去來今
text_en: Clearly and thoroughly understooda hair’s breadth of difference. Heaven and earth are far apart If you wish it to appear before you, do not continue to follow along or oppose. Opposing and agreeing contend with each other This is called the disease of the mind. Not knowing the profound meaningin vain you labor in thoughts of stillness Perfectly round like the great void lacking nothing and nothing in excess indeed because of grasping and rejecting therefore it is not thus do not chase conditioned existence do not abide in empty forbearance With a single kind of even mind naturally all is extinguished stopping movement and returning to stillness stopping again only increases movement merely clinging to the two sides how could one know the single kind The single kind is not penetrated. In both places the work is lost. Dismiss being and there is no non-being. Following emptiness yet turning away from emptiness. Much speech and much thought. Turn ever more out of accord Cut off words and cut off thought nowhere is there that is not penetrated return to the root and obtain the meaning Following illumination, you lose the source in an instant turn the light back it surpasses the previous emptiness The former emptiness undergoes change all because of deluded views there is no need to seek the true Only cease from views let not the two views abide take care not to pursue them As soon as there is right and wrong confusion arises and the mind is lost the two arise from the one but do not cling even to the one when the one mind is not born the myriad dharmas are without fault Without fault, without dharmas not born, not mind the subject can follow conditions and cease conditions follow the subject and sink away conditions arise from the subject as conditions the subject arises from conditions as subject If you wish to know these two aspects their origin is a single emptiness the one emptiness is the same as the two Equally containing the myriad forms without seeing fine or coarse how could there be partiality or faction The Great Way is vast in essence neither easy nor difficult with narrow views there is doubt and suspicion The more hurried, the more delayed grasping it, you lose the measure the mind enters a deviant path Let it go and it is natural the essence neither goes nor abides accord with your nature and unite with the Way At ease and free from vexation to fix the mind is to stray from the true Sinking into dullness is not good If it is not good, it wearies the spirit what use are estrangement and intimacy if you wish to approach the One Vehicle do not hate the six sense-objects when the six sense-objects are not hated they are the same as right awakening The wise are without contrivance the foolish bind themselves the dharma has no different dharma yet delusion gives rise to attachment using mind to seek mind is this not a great mistake Delusion gives rise to quiet and disturbance in awakening there is no liking or disliking all the two sides are foolishly weighed and measured dreams, illusions, empty flowers why trouble to grasp them Gain and loss, right and wrong let them all go at once if the eye does not sleep all dreams will naturally cease if the mind makes no distinctions the myriad dharmas are of one suchness The one suchness is profound in essence abruptly forgetting conditions the myriad dharmas are viewed equally returning again to what is natural obliterating the reasons why it cannot be compared by analogy Stopping movement, there is no movement in movement, there is no stopping when the two are not established how could the one exist ultimately and to the utmost not abiding by rules Awaken the mind of equality all activities cease doubt is completely purified Right faith is even and upright nothing is retained there is nothing to remember Empty and luminous, self- so without exerting mental effort a place beyond thought Consciousness and feeling are hard to fathom true suchness is the dharma-realm without other and without self To accord swiftly just speak of non-duality in non-duality all is the same There is nothing it does not embrace the wise of the ten directions all enter this teaching The teaching is neither hurried nor delayed one thought is ten thousand years ten thousand years are one thought there is no here or not-here The ten directions are right before the eyes the extremely small is the same as the great delusion ends and boundaries vanish The extremely great is the same as the small no boundaries are seen being is precisely non-being Non-being is precisely being if it is not thus you need not hold to it One is all all is one if only you can be thus why worry that it will not be complete faith and mind are not two non-dual are faith and mind The path of words is cut off not past present or future
The End of the Xinxin Ming
